<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v2/didcomm/invitations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Without `connectionId`, creates a standalone Out-of-Band invitation that names the DID of the agent, with no label, no image and no attachment, and returns it with its short URL. With `connectionId`, sends the invitation on that connection: a v1 connection carries the Out-of-Band 1.1 message, and a v2 connection carries the Out-of-Band 2.0 invitation in the `application/didcomm-plain+json` attachment of a Media Sharing share-media message. Without `did`, that invitation opens a single-use sub-connection to this agent, correlated through `parentConnectionId`. With `did`, it refers the peer to that service and creates no record.
